description.value: Crown Isle is an 871-acre Canadian-owned full-service resort and residential golf community situated in the Comox Valley near Courtenay on Vancouver Island, centred on an award-winning Platinum-rated 18-hole championship golf course with views of the Beaufort range and Comox Glacier. The resort complex includes 114 suites, villas, and cottages, plus the Timber Room Bar & Grill overlooking the 18th green and a fitness centre within the clubhouse. Touring cyclists exploring the Comox Valley will find a polished, amenity-rich base with on-site dining in an accessible location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Crown Isle is a real, operating full-service resort at 399 Clubhouse Drive, Courtenay, BC — matching the OSM address and phone. The resort page confirms 114 suites/villas/cottages and on-site dining (Timber Room Bar & Grill), but nowhere in the website content is there any mention of bicycle storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, drying rooms, e-bike charging, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those all remain null. The OSM name references the specific clubhouse building while the website brands the overall property as 'Crown Isle Resort & Golf Community', which is a minor naming discrepancy worth flagging.
concerns: OSM name 'Crown Isle Resort Clubhouse' refers specifically to the clubhouse building, while the website brands the full property as 'Crown Isle Resort & Golf Community' — the OSM record may be scoped to just the clubhouse structure rather than the overall accommodation property.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating full-service resort with confirmed accommodation; a legitimate base for touring cyclists in the Comox Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Toll-free number 1-888-338-8439 also listed on website in addition to the local 250-703-5000. Email info@crownisle.com available on website but not in OSM tags.

Nearby evening food.detail: The Timber Room Bar & Grill is on-site at the clubhouse, described as serving west coast cuisine with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the 18th green
